title: Micro-Repair
concept: Smallest recovery unit: soften tone, 2% move, side-by-side, acknowledge impact before residue hardens.
whenToUse: Tone sharpens; small hurts; residue starting; full repair feels impossible but waiting will worsen Tone Spiral.
steps: Shift side-by-side if face-to-face is too hot.
Tiny next step — or Pause + Return.
working: Sharp sink reply → soft reset in 30 seconds → sofa side-by-side → one ownership → residue cleared before bed.
notWorking: Waiting for “the real talk this weekend” while nightly tone stays brittle. Micro-repairs skipped; spiral installs.
activity: Pick one unfinished friction <48h old. Deliver softness + ownership + ask within 10 minutes today.
